# Example CLI dump, written by hand as a test fixture.
# The same craft as example_diff.txt after a tuning session, so the two can
# be compared. Not from a real aircraft.

# diff all

# version
# Betaflight / STM32F405 (S405) 4.4.2 Jun  5 2023 / 06:31:34 (7c5770c1c)

board_name MATEKF405
manufacturer_id MTKS

# feature
feature -RX_PARALLEL_PWM
feature RX_SERIAL
feature TELEMETRY
feature AIRMODE

# serial
serial 0 64 115200 57600 0 115200

# master
set gyro_lpf1_static_hz = 250
set gyro_lpf2_static_hz = 500
set dyn_notch_count = 3
set dyn_notch_q = 300
set dyn_notch_min_hz = 150
set dyn_notch_max_hz = 700
set rpm_filter_harmonics = 3
set dshot_bidir = ON
set motor_poles = 14
set motor_pwm_protocol = DSHOT600
set failsafe_procedure = DROP
set gyro_to_use = FIRST
set simplified_gyro_filter_multiplier = 90

profile 0
set p_roll = 52
set i_roll = 80
set d_roll = 44
set d_min_roll = 32
set p_pitch = 54
set i_pitch = 84
set d_pitch = 50
set d_min_pitch = 36
set p_yaw = 45
set i_yaw = 80
set d_yaw = 0
set dterm_lpf1_static_hz = 145
set dterm_lpf2_static_hz = 145
set feedforward_transition = 0

rateprofile 0
set rates_type = ACTUAL
set roll_rc_rate = 14
set pitch_rc_rate = 14
set yaw_rc_rate = 12
set roll_expo = 0
set roll_srate = 67

save
